name: gmr-cmu137-segscale
command:
.venv/bin/python -u tools_amc_csv_f1.py --asf downloads/cmu137/137.asf --amc downloads/cmu137/137_24.amc --output_file whole_body_tracking/motions/csv/cmu137_24_f1.csv 2>&1 | grep -E "scale|travel|Saved|warn" | tail -5 && .venv/bin/python tools_check_motion_f1.py --csv whole_body_tracking/motions/csv/cmu137_24_f1.csv --fps 30 --json_out whole_body_tracking/motions/quality_cmu137_24_f1_csv.json 2>&1 | python3 -c "
import json,sys
d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read().split('\n',1)[1])
g=d['ground']; s=d['self_penetration']
print(f\"ground {g['min_foot_z_m']:.4f} @f{g['frame']} pass={g['pass']} | self {s['min_pair_distance_m']:.4f} pass={s['pass']} | limits={d['joint_limits']['pass']} vel={d['joint_velocities']['pass']} hgt=[{d['root_height']['min_m']:.2f},{d['root_height']['max_m']:.2f}] pass={d['root_height']['pass']} | OVERALL={d['overall_pass']}\")"
